zh-CN.title: 连续五夜，让星空住进聊天
items: 空间管理员可认领限时 15 天的五夜星旋活动，认领后才会在广场展示
北京时间连续 5 晚在 20:00–24:00 聊天，可永久解锁典藏动态背景“星夜回旋”

en.title: Five nights bring the stars into chat
items: Space admins can claim the 15-day Five Nights event; its Square banner appears only after claiming
Chat between 20:00 and 24:00 Beijing time for five consecutive evenings to permanently unlock the Collector Starry Rotation background
